description: Verify a Bitcoin address (Bech32m P2TR, Bech32 P2WPKH/P2WSH, Base58 P2PKH/P2SH): network, type, witness version, scriptPubKey hex, and common pitfalls. Never send private keys or seed phrases. Free tier: 2 calls/day per IP; after that, pass a WorkSats `creditToken` (`crd_...`), L402 header, or Base USDC `x402TxHash`.

address.description: Bitcoin address to inspect (bc1p..., bc1q..., 1..., 3..., tb1...).

creditToken.description: Optional WorkSats bearer credit token (`crd_...`) to pay 2 credits when free daily calls are used up.

x402TxHash.description: Optional confirmed Base mainnet USDC transfer transaction hash (`0x...`) to pay via x402.

name: check_bitcoin_address
